proposals.before: Once my underling, he showed the grit of Zhong and Yu and the blunt honor of Shi Yu, tightened my slack rule and steeled my cowardice, and saved me from fault—that merit is mine to repay.
proposals.after: Once my underling, he showed loyal and resolute conduct and personally embodied the integrity of Shi Yu, tightened my slack rule and steeled my cowardice, and saved me from fault—that merit is mine to repay.
proposals.reason: Chinese 忠毅之操 is loyal-resolute conduct parallel to 史魚之節, not two men named Zhong and Yu.

proposals.before: Formerly, when he was a menial attendant serving with your servant, he displayed the devotion of Zhong and Yu and personally embodied the integrity of Shi Yu, tightened your servant's slack discipline, and stiffened your servant's timidity, so that your servant escaped blame—truly we rely on his merit.
proposals.after: Formerly, when he was a menial attendant serving with your servant, he displayed loyal and resolute conduct and personally embodied the integrity of Shi Yu, tightened your servant's slack discipline, and stiffened your servant's timidity, so that your servant escaped blame—truly we rely on his merit.
proposals.reason: Chinese 忠毅之操 names virtues, not persons Zhong and Yu; only 史魚 is a person.

proposals.before: One dawn at the kitchen a gale struck; she ran to the hall and begged leave to go home to her parents.
proposals.after: One dawn at the kitchen a gale struck; she ran to the hall and begged her mother-in-law for leave to go home and take leave of her two parents.
proposals.reason: After 從姑求歸, 辭其二親 means bid farewell to her own parents, not parents-in-law.

proposals.before: One morning when she went to the cook-shed, suddenly a violent wind sprang up; the woman at once went up to the hall and begged her mother-in-law to let her return home, taking leave of both parents-in-law.
proposals.after: One morning when she went to the cook-shed, suddenly a violent wind sprang up; the woman at once went up to the hall and begged her mother-in-law to let her return home, taking leave of her two parents.
proposals.reason: 辭其二親 refers to her birth parents after asking the mother-in-law for leave to return.

proposals.before: Once ill, he rose from bed to return a maid's courtesy sent by Chen Shi's wife.
proposals.after: Once when he was ill, his wife sent a maid to bow and inquire; he got down from the bed and returned the bow.
proposals.reason: Chinese 妻遣婢 is Fan Ying’s own wife sending a maid; the idiomatic English wrongly attributes the wife to Chen Shi.

proposals.before: Sun Ling flattered the palace eunuchs under Emperor Ling and rose to minister of education.
proposals.after: His grandson Ling, in Emperor Ling’s time, by flattering the eunuchs became minister of education.
proposals.reason: 孫陵 means “grandson Ling,” not a man surnamed Sun; Fan Ying’s grandson is at issue.

proposals.before: Sun Ling, in the time of Emperor Ling, by fawning on the eunuchs became minister of education.
proposals.after: Grandson Ling, in the time of Emperor Ling, by fawning on the eunuchs became minister of education.
proposals.reason: Same kinship misread: 孫陵 is grandson Ling, not the surname-plus-name Sun Ling.

proposals.before: His ancestor Zhang Jiang had been enfeoffed as Marquis of Zhe; a great-grandson's state became governor of Yulin and moved to Guanghan, whereupon they took the clan name from the fief.
proposals.after: His ancestor Zhang Jiang had been enfeoffed as Marquis of Zhe; great-grandson Guo became governor of Yulin and moved to Guanghan, whereupon they took the clan name from the fief.
proposals.reason: 曾孫國 is the personal name Guo (great-grandson Guo), not “a great-grandson’s state.”

decisions.after: When he served under me, he displayed loyal resolve and the integrity of Shi Yu. He tightened my lax discipline, strengthened my weak resolve, and kept me from fault; I truly owe that to his merit.
decisions.reason: 忠毅 describes loyal and resolute conduct rather than two people named Zhong and Yu. The revision also removes the colloquial 'underling' while preserving the memorialist’s first-person voice.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 昔為陪隸，與臣從事，奮忠毅之操，躬史魚之節

decisions.reason: 忠毅之操 means loyal and resolute conduct; only the following 史魚 is a personal name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 奮忠毅之操，躬史魚之節

decisions.after: One morning, as she entered the kitchen, a violent wind suddenly arose. She went to the hall and asked her mother-in-law to let her return home to bid farewell to her parents.
decisions.reason: 姑 is her mother-in-law, from whom she requests permission; 二親 are the two parents in her natal home to whom she wishes to say farewell.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 婦便上堂從姑求歸，辭其二親。

decisions.after: One morning when she went to the cook-shed, a violent wind suddenly sprang up. The woman at once went up to the hall and asked her mother-in-law to let her return home to take leave of her two parents.
decisions.reason: The existing literal translation wrongly makes 二親 the parents-in-law. They are her own two parents, whom she asks leave to visit before her predicted death.

decisions.after: While Fan Ying was ill, Chen Shi’s wife sent a maid to pay her respects and ask after him; he rose from his sickbed and returned the bow.
decisions.reason: The proposal reverses the correct attribution. Chen Shi remains the subject from the preceding sentence, and Fan Ying’s explanation that a wife is her husband’s equal explains why he honors the maid sent by Chen Shi’s wife.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 潁川陳寔，少從英學。嘗有疾，妻遣婢拜問，英下床答拜。寔怪而問之。英曰：「妻，齊也。共奉祭祀，禮無不答。」

decisions.after: His grandson Ling rose to Minister of Education under Emperor Ling by flattering the eunuchs.
decisions.reason: 孫 is the kinship term 'grandson,' not the surname Sun. The revision retains Ling’s office and the means by which he obtained it in direct English.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 孫陵，靈帝時以諂事宦人為司徒。

decisions.after: His grandson Ling, in Emperor Ling’s time, became Minister of Education by fawning on the eunuchs.
decisions.reason: 孫陵 parses as the kinship term 'grandson' followed by the personal name Ling; it is not the surname-plus-name Sun Ling.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 孫陵，靈帝時以諂事宦人為司徒。

decisions.after: His ancestor Zhang Jiang was enfeoffed as Marquis of Zhe; Jiang’s great-grandson Guo became Administrator of Yulin and moved to Guanghan, after which the family took the fief’s name as its surname.
decisions.reason: 曾孫國 identifies a great-grandson named Guo. The existing translation mistakes 國 for the common noun 'state' and consequently loses the subject of the following offices and migration.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 其先張江者，封折侯，曾孫國為鬱林太守，徙廣漢，因封氏焉。國生像。

claimRetractions.reason: The wife in this scene belongs to Chen Shi, the subject carried forward from s0347, not to Fan Ying. The Fan Ying spouse edge is therefore a translation artifact.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 潁川陳寔，少從英學。嘗有疾，妻遣婢拜問，英下床答拜。寔怪而問之。

claimRevisions.reason: The anonymous woman is Chen Shi’s wife. The revised descriptive name keeps her as a distinct person while assigning the correct spouse.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 潁川陳寔，少從英學。嘗有疾，妻遣婢拜問，英下床答拜。寔怪而問之。

claimAdditions.reason: The wife’s possessor is Chen Shi from the preceding sentence. Adding the source-backed spouse edge preserves the family relationship exposed by the corrected reading.
